author: SickProdigy
description: Provider-neutral multichain testnet wallet integration for Red-DiscordBot.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores wallet profile identifiers, linked platform identifiers, public wallet addresses, public transaction metadata, notification preferences, and emergency-lock status. It never stores private keys, recovery phrases, wallet passwords, or one-time authentication codes.
install_msg: This cog is an early multichain testnet prototype. The companion site is for wallet authorization and protected key export; ordinary wallet provisioning happens through bot commands. Do not use it with real funds.
